about_the_game:
An ordinary farmer, pushed by a somewhat clumsy but confident goddess, embarks on an unusual journey to defeat the Demon King.

One day, a goddess appears before a farmer. The goddess, who wields the mysterious power of a loop, pushes you, a simple farmer, to defeat the Demon King. Clueless, you become a hero and set off to face the king. Oh wait, there aren't enough monsters to farm to defeat the Demon King. But with the goddess's power, you can defeat the same slime dozens, even hundreds of times, right?

Play

Until The Hero is a simple deck-building game!

Defeat monsters and create your item deck to gain a higher combat power. Strategically place various items in your inventory to create synergies and become the strongest farmer in the world, with exponentially increased power!

Additionally, use the goddess's mysterious loop stone to defeat a monster, revive it, defeat it again, and repeat! You can loop infinitely until you get the items you want!

Content

In Until The Hero, enjoy a wide variety of loot and countless deck combinations through synergies. Face the Demon King, a powerful being who stands against a hero wielding the power of a loop, and collect spectacular skins that will make you feel like more than just a farmer!

Join us on the journey of an ordinary farmer who becomes a legendary hero, defeating countless monsters and the Demon King to save the world!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 / AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 630 / AMD Radeon HD 6670 (2 GB, DX11)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs on most low-end desktops and laptops
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3570 / AMD FX-8300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 (2 GB, DX12)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Smooth performance with post-processing effects enabled

short_description: Transform a simple farmer into a legendary hero with the magic of a loop! Farm endlessly and grow stronger than the Demon King. Combine items to grow stronger even faster! Write your own legendary tale with the power granted by the Goddess!
